app_navigation_configuration._readme: Flow logic only — NO ad IDs here (ads come from remote_config_json). Fields starting with _ are documentation and are ignored by the parser; keep or delete them freely.

splash._show_consent_help: true = show Google UMP consent form on splash before continuing; false = skip it.
splash._get_started_variant_help: 0 = direct flow, no button (navigate immediately) | 1 = 'Get Started' button + Banner ad | 2 = button + Native ad | 3 = button only. Set independently for a first-time vs a returning user.

flows._flows_help: Ordered screens visited AFTER splash, per launch type. When a screen finishes, the next applicable step in the same list opens; 'main' ends the journey (and is implied if the list runs out). To move Premium, move it in the list. Screens: language | onboarding | premium | offer | main. A step is a screen name, or { "screen": ..., "ad_before": ..., "enabled": true, "skip_if_done": true }. ad_before: none | interstitial | app_open | app_open_then_interstitial (app-open, and an interstitial if it could not be shown). language/onboarding are skipped when already done unless skip_if_done is false; premium and offer are skipped for premium users; offer (the limited-time deal) is also skipped once its two-hour clock has run out.
flows._first_launch_help: New user (language not selected OR onboarding not done). Examples: Premium right after splash = ["premium","language","onboarding","main"] | after language = ["language","premium","onboarding","main"] | after onboarding = ["language","onboarding","premium","main"]. An interstitial before language = [{"screen":"language","ad_before":"interstitial"},"onboarding","main"].
flows._second_launch_help: Returning user (language selected AND onboarding done). Examples: Premium first = ["premium","main"] | App-open then Main = [{"screen":"main","ad_before":"app_open"}] | Interstitial then Premium then Main = [{"screen":"premium","ad_before":"interstitial"},"main"].

screens._screens_help: Optional per-screen, per-launch refinements (keys: screen name, then first_launch / second_launch). enabled:false skips that screen for that launch type. ad_before applies when the step itself sets none. ad_on_close = ad shown when the screen is closed back to where it came from (e.g. Premium opened from Settings, Language opened from Settings).
